metaTitle: CROSSING PROXY | Life services in Taiwan
metaDescription: CROSSING PROXY helps foreign residents in Taiwan with translation, everyday documents, scooter buying and selling, SIM cards, shipping, and daily questions. Language and country are separate. Unconfirmed prices, cities, and credentials stay marked as pending.
position: CROSSING PROXY is a one-stop life-service partner for foreign residents in Taiwan.
heroLead: See what is open and what the limits are, then ask on LINE. Unconfirmed prices, addresses, and reviews are not shown here.
heroPoints: Who we are: CROSSING PROXY, also known as 越境代辦.
What we can help with: translation, documents, scooter sales, SIM cards, shipping, and daily questions. Rentals and company plans are not open yet.
Languages: 繁體中文, English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Filipino.
Where to start: pick a country, open a service card, and read the status and limits.
How to reach us: LINE official account @681ydjcz.
countryHelp: Language changes the words. Country changes the specific services. You can read in English and still select Vietnam.

faq.q: If I read the site in English, can I still find Vietnam services?
faq.a: Yes. Change the language at the top, then set the country to Vietnam. Words and the service list are separate.

faq.q: Do you file visas, residence permits, or work permits?
faq.a: We do not act as an immigration, visa, or residence-permit agent, and we do not promise any government result. Document help means explaining, organizing, and translating. Work that needs a legal qualification is not labeled as a partner referral until a real licensed partner is confirmed.
Prices are not published. There is no starting price on this site. Ask on LINE. We explain how the fee is calculated before we begin.

faq.q: What cannot be shipped to Vietnam?
faq.a: From the owner's own public guidance: meat and meat products are not accepted; batteries and power banks are restricted; liquids and medicine are usually restricted too. Rules change, so confirm again before you ship. The full prohibited-item text from the old website could not be recovered from the suspended account, so this is not that original list.

faq.q: Can I rent a scooter or furniture?
faq.a: Not yet. Short- and medium-term scooter rental, and household or furniture rental, are planned. An inquiry only records interest. It is not a booking.
No. We do not collect or send money. If social posts compared legal transfer options, that was general information, not a paid service on this site.

faq.q: Does this website store the form?
faq.a: No. The page is static. After you copy the text, it stays on your device until you paste it into LINE. Do not enter an ID, passport, ARC number, or other sensitive data.

pendingStrip: Prices, cities, address, licenses, team details, and customer cases that the owner has not provided are marked pending. They are not filled in.
legal: These notes follow the direction of current Taiwan rules. They are not legal advice. Immigration, visas, residence permits, private employment services, transport and shipping permits, and scooter-rental contracts and insurance are not offered as something we can do directly, or as a partner referral, until the owner confirms the qualification or a real licensed partner.
We do not guarantee a visa, a job, residence, or any government approval. Whether a document is accepted is decided by the authority.
A first question does not ask for an ID card, passport, ARC, or other sensitive data. Do not put that data in a public URL or in this static form.

Whether shipping and home pickup already have the required permits is pending. Until that is confirmed, the description is help with questions and the existing shipping flow. It is not a claim that we hold a particular transport license.
Help with buying or selling a scooter does not replace registration, insurance, or traffic rules. Short- and medium-term rental is not open, so there is no rental contract to sign.
